Smith Center]] |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2023–24 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 George Washington Revolutionaries men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team, led by second-year head coach [[Chris Caputo]], played their home games at [[Charles E. Smith Center]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as a member of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]] (A-10). They finished the season 15–17, 4–14 in [[2023–24 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]], to finish in last (15th) place.{{Cite web |title=2023-24 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://atlantic10.com/standings.aspx?standings=156 |access-date=2024-10-22 |website=atlantic10.com}} On May 24, 2023, the school changed the nickname of its athletic teams to Revolutionaries.{{Cite web |date=2023-05-24 |title=It's Revolutionaries! |url=https://gwtoday.gwu.edu/its-revolutionaries |access-date=2023-11-08 |website=GW Today |language=en}} The school's teams were previously nicknamed the Colonials.{{Cite web |last=Axson |first=Scooby |date=2022-06-15 |title=George Washington University to stop using 'Colonials' name by 2023-24 |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/college/2022/06/15/george-washington-university-stop-using-colonials-name-2023-24/7635549001/ |access-date=2023-11-08 |website=USA Today |language=en-US}} ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Colonials]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 16–16, 10–8 in [[2022–23 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]], to finish in a tie for sixth place.{{Cite news |title=2022-23 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://atlantic10.com/standings.aspx?standings=144 |access-date=December 10, 2023 |work=Atlantic 10}} They lost to [[2022–23 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Saint Joseph's]] in the second round of the [[2023 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]].{{Cite news |date=March 8, 2023 |title=Men's Basketball Bows Out in Second Round, 87-76 |url=https://gwsports.com/news/2023/3/8/mens-basketball-mens-basketball-bows-out-in-second-round-87-76 |access-date=December 10, 2023 |work=George Washington University Athletics |language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
